32.
The Commission shall enter into an agreement with
every  authorised  person  setting  out  inter  alia  any  terms,
conditions, restrictions attached, the total value of the foreign
direct investment committed to be made (inclusive of any
sum  paid  in  terms  of  section  39),  and  any  concessions  or
exemptions  and  the  period  pertaining  to  which  they  are
granted under this Act, in relation to the investment to be
engaged  in  within  the  Area  of  Authority  of  the  Colombo
Port City. Every such agreement shall include a provision
whereby the parties agree to the resolution of any dispute
concerning thereof or arising therefrom, by way of arbitration
in terms of Part XIII of this Act.  Any equity contribution
made as provided for in subsection (5) of section 27 shall
also be separately reflected therein.
